paragraphs.en: A good looking terminal emulator which mimics the old cathode display...
paragraphs.zh: 一个外观精美的终端模拟器，模仿老式阴极显示器……

paragraphs.en: cool-retro-term is a terminal emulator which mimics the look and feel of the old cathode tube screens. It has been designed to be eye-candy, customizable, and reasonably lightweight.
paragraphs.zh: cool-retro-term 是一个模拟老式阴极射线管屏幕外观与感觉的终端模拟器。 它的设计目标是视觉上赏心悦目、可高度自定义，同时保持相对轻量。

sents.en: cool-retro-term is a terminal emulator which mimics the look and feel of the old cathode tube screens.
sents.zh: cool-retro-term 是一个模拟老式阴极射线管屏幕外观与感觉的终端模拟器。

sents.en: It has been designed to be eye-candy, customizable, and reasonably lightweight.
sents.zh: 它的设计目标是视觉上赏心悦目、可高度自定义，同时保持相对轻量。

paragraphs.en: It uses the QML port of qtermwidget (Konsole): https://github.com/Swordfish90/qmltermwidget .
paragraphs.zh: 它使用了 qtermwidget（Konsole）的 QML 移植版本：https://github.com/Swordfish90/qmltermwidget 。

paragraphs.en: This terminal emulator works under Linux and macOS and requires Qt6.
paragraphs.zh: 此终端模拟器可在 Linux 和 macOS 下运行，并且需要 Qt6。

paragraphs.en: Settings such as colors, fonts, and effects can be accessed via context menu.
paragraphs.zh: 颜色、字体和效果等设置可通过上下文菜单访问。

paragraphs.en: If you want to get a hold of the latest version, just go to the Releases page and grab the latest AppImage (Linux) or dmg (macOS).
paragraphs.zh: 如果您想获取最新版本，只需前往 Releases 页面，下载最新的 AppImage（Linux）或 dmg（macOS）即可。

paragraphs.en: Alternatively, most distributions such as Ubuntu, Fedora or Arch already package cool-retro-term in their official repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 或者，大多数发行版（如 Ubuntu、Fedora 或 Arch）已经在它们的官方软件仓库中打包了 cool-retro-term。

paragraphs.en: Check out the wiki and follow the instructions on how to build it on Linux and macOS .
paragraphs.zh: 请查看 wiki，并按照其中关于如何在 Linux 和 macOS 上构建的说明进行操作。
